paper_title: VeriPhy: Agentic Physical Reasoning for World Model Evaluation and Refinement

sections.title: Abstract
sections.content: Visual fluency in generated video does not imply physical reliability, and a scalar quality score alone is incapable of indicating the obligation a clip violates or the moment it fails. We present VeriPhy, an auditable physical-verification system in which a text-only planner compiles the prompt into typed physical obligations and a statically validated execution plan before any frame is observed. During execution, observations gate and scope only declared calls to frozen low-level experts (e.g., segmentation and tracking, counting, eleven typed physical measurements over the resulting tracks, depth, OCR, and audio-event detection). Each action returns a provenance-carrying evidence record whose payload, when usable, is either a typed measurement or an explicitly tagged learned state. Typed resolvers and fixed composition map usable records to a three-valued state (supported, contradicted, or unknown, surfaced as plausible, implausible, or abstain) with full provenance, so that every verdict is traceable to the evidence that produced it. We anchor evaluation in a 1,500-clip corpus of human-annotated flaw records that localize real generation failures in prompt reference, space, and time. On a 149-clip core carrying 304 such records, VeriPhy accounts for 228, against 164 for a published question-decomposition evaluator given the same clips and the same claims. Recall alone does not separate it from prompting the same backbone monolithically, which reaches 222; what separates them is that each decision retains its evidence record and provenance, making the traces auditable one verdict at a time and usable as the interface through which a critic verdict could be written back into generation.

sections.title: 1 Introduction
sections.content: Contemporary video generation systems can synthesize visually compelling, temporally coherent clips with synchronized audio. Perceptual plausibility, however, is not evidence of physical validity: failure may arise not only in rendered appearance but in any observable consequence of physical event. Within the visual stream, entities may be omitted, trajectories may be inconsistent with the forces implied by the scene, and interactions may violate contact or causal constraints. Within the acoustic stream, an expected sound may be absent, mistimed, or attributed to the wrong source; across modalities, visual and acoustic observations may encode incompatible event timing or causality. Thus an object may remain unsupported under gravity, ball may pass through rigid wall, visible collision may be silent, or the sound of an impact precede contact. These failures become especially consequential as generated video moves beyond media synthesis into the training and evaluation loops of embodied systems. Recent video world models have been used to synthesize robot-training trajectories, support policy learning and evaluation, and reduce the sim-to-real gap; stronger world models have also been associated with better downstream policy performance [29, 32, 63]. Recently, evaluation has expanded beyond generic video quality to embodied task correctness and rule-level physical diagnosis [4, 15, 38, 42], while complementary work has introduced temporal localization and the evaluation of acoustic or cross-modal physical consistency [9, 14, 77, 88]. 1 Prior baseline VeriPhy Text-only planner before frames auditable execution Generated A/V runtime Claim Closed question VLM yes / no Plan what to check how to check Action Observation Evidence record Fixed composition Claim state No measurement trace VeriPhy loop gate / scope Evidence trace one shared A/V clock Observed Expected Generated 0 wall contact 2 Penetration Expected rebound 1 floor contact Audio waveform 3 observed floor impact expected wall impact 0 1 2 Sample prompt: spinning basketball bounces on the floor and rebounds from rigid wall; impact sounds align with contact. Figure 1 Overview of VeriPhy relative to question decomposition. The numbered views magnify rotation, floor-contact deformation, generated wall penetration, and the counterfactual rigid-wall rebound; the waveform shares the visual event clock. The scene is illustrative rather than recorded execution. Despite this progress, recent evaluators capture complementary components of physical diagnosis rather than single auditable evidence chain. They provide rule-level judgments [4, 42], temporal localization [9, 88], measurement-grounded tests in controlled settings [73], and audio-physical or cross-modal consistency checks [77, 92]. These capabilities are nevertheless typically organized as benchmark-specific protocols built around curated datasets, predefined phenomena, or manually authored rubrics. The recent AV-Phys Agent is particularly close point of comparison: it combines reasoningaction loop with deterministic acoustic tools, but its released protocol remains tied to prompt-specific human-authored rubrics and multimodal-model binary judgments [14]. The ballwall schematic in Figure 1, which illustrates the interface rather than recorded execution, makes the resulting integration gap concrete: defensible verdict must establish that the ball and wall are present, localize floorand wall-contact windows, measure trajectory and relative geometry, and determine whether any detected impact sound aligns with the wall-contact window. Although audio events can be detected in parallel, synchrony cannot be resolved until that visual window is available. Unusable evidence leaves the dependent claim unknown; if no claim is contradicted, any unknown makes the clip abstain, while terminal infrastructure failure remains separate outcome. The gap targeted here is therefore not the absence of any one component, but their integration within single evaluator that compiles the prompt into typed physical obligations and statically validated plan, lets observations gate and scope already-declared specialist calls, and uses fixed rules to compose usable evidence records (typed measurements or explicitly tagged learned states) into three-valued decisions with traceable time windows, tool outputs, values, rules, and provenance. VeriPhy addresses these requirements as single physical-verification system comprised of text-only planner, video-aware semantic verifier, frozen specialist operators, and fixed composition. For open-ended prompts that provide no evaluation rubric, the planner operates before any frame is seen, compiling exact prompt spans into typed physical obligations and statically validated execution plan. For evidence distributed across entities, events, time, and modalities, the verifier reads timestamped frames densely on shared A/V clock; its observations activate, skip, or localize only calls already declared by the plan, and those scoped calls dispatch SAM 3 grounding and tracking [7], identity-based counting, eleven track-based physical measurements, monocular depth, optical character recognition, and audio-event detection [24]. For heterogeneous or unusable outputs, each action emits claim-bound record containing either typed measurement or an explicitly tagged 2 learned base state, together with its realized scope, measured/abstained/errored status, artifact hashes, cost, and provenance. Typed resolvers and fixed composition map usable records to supported, contradicted, or unknown claim states and then to plausible, implausible, or abstain at clip level; unavailable evidence remains unknown, while terminal infrastructure failures remain separate. For opaque verdicts, the system returns an auditable claim-level trace linking each decision to its prompt span, planned calls, localized evidence, and composition rule. Together, these components turn an open prompt and generated A/V clip into dependency-aware evidence chain rather than an unordered set of model answers. Figure 1 contrasts this design with the evaluated question-decomposition baseline, which asks one closed yes/no question per claim without measurement trace. To evaluate the critic at the granularity of its trace, we assemble corpus of 1,500 generated clips with 2,582 human-written, prompt-grounded flaw records. Each record quotes the violated prompt span and provides rationale, severity, confidence, and, when available, temporal span and object track; these records are the only ground truth used here. flaw-level protocol scores each system finding as whole, partial, or missed against the corresponding human record. On 149-clip recall analysis, VeriPhy accounts for 228 of 304 annotated defects, compared with 164 for published question-decomposition evaluator given the same clips, claims, and served model. monolithic prompt to that same backbone accounts for 222, so recall alone does not isolate the value of the agentic organization; the principal distinction is that every VeriPhy decision retains its supporting evidence and provenance. This analysis is recall-only, single-annotator, and not held out, and therefore characterizes the current system rather than its generalization (Section 5.3). VeriPhy casts physically grounded generation of, and verdict on, clip for its prompt as two maps we build and benchmark separately: generation map ˆV Gen(p, C), the control-conditioned video diffusion of Section 3, and an evaluation map = Crit(V, p), the auditable critic of Section 4. Both maps and the clip-level verdict are made precise there. In summary, our contributions are threefold: (i) VeriPhy, an integrated physical-verification system that compiles prompts into typed obligations, scopes specialist operators with observations, and returns threevalued decisions with localized evidence and provenance; (ii) the 1,500-clip corpus and its flaw-level matching protocol; and (iii) simulation-conditioned generation testbed in which known MuJoCo geometry is rendered as depth or silhouette control for frozen Wan 2.2-VACE generator [33, 70, 71]. The current report evaluates the critic and generator separately. Together, these contributions provide an auditable evaluation stack and concrete interface for future physical refinement.

sections.title: 2 Related Work
sections.content: Physics-aware generation and refinement. Controllable video generation separates appearance synthesis from structural guidance by conditioning diffusion models on depth, segmentation, reference frames, masks, motion fields, and compositional spatiotemporal signals [33, 71, 74, 87]. Such interfaces determine how geometric information enters generator, but do not by themselves establish that either the condition or the synthesized pixels obey physical laws. complementary line derives control from physical reasoning or simulation: scene properties can be inferred and reconstructed for simulation, simulated trajectories or flow can guide synthesis, textual physical context can refine prompt, and language can be compiled into coarse motion plan. More recent research introduces continuous controls over physical properties or couples simulation and rendering directly with generation [2, 19, 45, 54, 56, 80, 83, 86]. Evaluation feedback has also been used for preference optimization, verifier-guided candidate search, and localized regeneration [20, 37, 44]. These studies pursue both pre-synthesis physical conditioning and evaluation-guided refinement. The present work decouples these two stages: simulator-derived metric depth or silhouette controls condition frozen video generator, while VeriPhy independently evaluates the resulting clip. This design distinguishes adherence to the control signal from physical validity in the synthesized output; feeding diagnoses back into regeneration remains future work. Model judgments, decomposition, and physical evaluation. Automated video evaluation has progressed from aggregate metrics toward increasingly structured model judgments. General protocols factor perceptual quality, temporal consistency, and prompt alignment, while learned VLM or MLLM 3 judges map prompt and clip to multidimensional ratings, discrete states, or natural-language explana- [26, 27, 31, 46, 47, 68]. Prompt-decomposition methods instead translate prompt into propotions sitions, questions, or query chains and revisit the visual input through smaller checks [10, 25, 28, 43]; the checks are explicit, although their supporting evidence is generally still produced by the judging model. Physics-oriented benchmarks further introduce phenomenon-, rule-, trajectory-, and prompt-specific criteria, criterion-level reasoning, failure localization, controlled measurements, and audiovisual consistency [3, 4, 8, 9, 14, 22, 42, 49, 51, 55, 73, 77, 88, 92]. Prior physical evaluation is therefore not uniformly scalar, unlocalized, visual-only, or unmeasured; rather, these capabilities remain distributed across evaluators with different scopes, output contracts, and evidence representations. Execution harnesses, context engineering, and persistent state. Execution harnesses separate orchestration from model judgment by making planning, dependencies, specialist routing, observation scope, validation, termination, and trace logging explicit [35, 60, 65, 78, 82]. Modular visual and video methods extend this organization with specialized perception, selective observation, and adaptive temporal sampling [13, 17, 23, 39, 52, 53, 67, 69, 75, 76], while video-evaluation pipelines already combine prompt structuring with temporal tools, formal specifications and model checking, localized repair, deterministic acoustic measurements, or prompt-specific rubrics [12, 14, 64, 84]. Across episodes, harness also constructs the context for each model call by storing, retrieving, filtering, and formatting persistent state; prior work distills trajectories into reflective lessons, reusable strategies, or structured knowledge without weight updates, and separates recorded evidence from derived beliefs to reduce context pollution [30, 36, 57, 66, 81, 90]. These components predate our work, and controlled studies show that additional tools or scaffolding may increase cost without improving accuracy [18, 34]. Relative to this literature, VeriPhy contributes their integration under common verification contract: open prompts are compiled into typed obligations and validated plan, observations only gate or scope declared calls, measurements remain distinct from learned states, and fixed rules produce initial three-valued claims with any review override preserved separately in the trace. Across episodes, it uses offline lessons from disjoint experience pool and separately evaluates an evolving in-context lesson state (Section B.7 and Section 5.3.4). The reported results therefore establish experience-conditioned harness execution, not autonomous self-improvement or open-ended replanning; automatic changes to tools, workflows, admission policies, and external knowledge remain future work.

sections.title: 3 Physics-Guided Simulation Pipeline
sections.content: Modern generators render physically plausible motion, yet prompt-driven synthesis supplies no known physical target: because physics and appearance are produced jointly, the intended trajectory, contact, or counterfactual is neither fixed in advance nor recoverable afterward, and every physical property stays confounded with appearance. An evaluation testbed instead needs target factored out of appearancespecified, known by construction, and auditable independently of generator capability. We obtain one from trusted physics solver and render it as geometric control, so the solver fixes the motion while the prompt supplies only appearance (Figure 2). This is developed across two stages: Section 3.2 turns the event description into validated target rendered as registered control, and Section 3.3 conditions the generator on that control and an appearance prompt. Whether the generated video realizes the target is the open question of Section 5.2.

sections.title: 3.3 Physics-conditioned video generation
sections.content: The generator is latent video-diffusion transformer that samples clip by iteratively denoising latent from noise. We use Wan 2.2 [71]: DiT-style denoiser run along flow-matching schedule of UniPC multistep iterations, indexed by from high noise to low as σi decreases (Equation (14)). On its own it is text-to-video generator conditioned only on an appearance prompt (subject, material, setting), with no input through which specified motion can be imposed. To make the motion controllable we adopt VACE [33], which augments frozen backbone with control branch: control video and generation mask are encoded into control features added into the backbones transformer blocks, so an external spatiotemporal signal steers generation without retraining the base weights [74, 87]. The composite Wan 2.2-VACE takes four inputs: the appearance prompt p, geometric control video C, generation mask , and scalar conditioning strength s. Because i∗ is an index, its noise level depends on the schedule, so the withdrawal point is reported as σrel = σi∗ ,

4 VeriPhy
sections.content: This section presents VeriPhy, an auditable multi-tool critic that adjudicates each generated clip against its prompt, returning three-valued verdict whose every decision traces back to the evidence that produced it. We score the critic against the human-annotated flaw benchmark of Section 5.1 under the matching protocol of Section 5.3.

sections.title:
4.1 System overview
VeriPhy is a constrained reason–act–observe critic with four roles. A text-only planner compiles the prompt
into typed physical claims and an executable measurement plan before seeing any frame (reason). Each
act step dispatches one of two backends: specialist instruments returning targeted measurements—counts,
tracks, masks, depths, text, and sound intervals—or a video-aware semantic verifier reading timestamped
frames densely for predicates like existence and event occurrence. Each observe step consumes the returned
measurement to gate, scope, and—via a deterministic aggregator —compose the plan’s declared physical
relations into a three-valued verdict. The governing invariant: tool outputs steer execution, but only within
obligations declared before any pixel is read. Backends are listed in Table 2; the planner and semantic verifier
may share a served checkpoint but are separate calls with different inputs and responsibilities. We situate this
design in the ReAct and tool-using-agent lineage in Section B.1.
sections.content: Two properties make the critic auditable. First, reasoning sits entirely up front: the planner compiles and statically validates the typed measurement plan before observing the video, following plan-before-act agents [35, 78] and code-as-plan systems that emit an executable program of visual primitives [23, 69]. Planning is thus global with respect to the promptthe naming pass sees the whole prompt and later claim groups share its vocabularywhile execution is local in time: observations activate, skip, or localize already-declared nodes. With the trajectory fixed before execution, every measurement traces to the obligation that requested it. Second, evidence production and adjudication stay separate: specialist operators return typed measurements, learned semantic base states are tagged in their evidence records, and deterministic composition over the usable records yields the verdict. These properties give traceable evidence chain behind every three-valued decision: supported, contradicted, or unknown. These states are surfaced as plausible, implausible, or abstain, respectively, and formalized in Section 4.5. We now fix notation for the objects these roles operate on. Timing is the one capability needing guard before its windows are used: returned window is not evidence the queried event occurred, since forced localizer may return its best candidate even for an absent event. Writing the sub-check states over the three-valued codomain = {S, C, U} (supported, contradicted, unknown; Section 4.5), relation {before, during} over occurrence states oA, oB and measured windows WA, WB resolves to contradicted if either operand is contradicted, to unknown if either is unknown or window is unavailable, and to the order predicate ρR(WA, WB) only when both events are supportedso timing may compose an order but never establish occurrence. That predicate ρR compares interval endpoints under boundary slack of one quarter of the shorter window (Equation (13) in Section A.1): an order is supported or contradicted only when one window ends before the other begins by more than the slack, otherwise U; the quarter-window rule prevents both directions from holding. Containment (during) uses the same slack. These predicates are tolerance-scaled subset of Allens interval algebra [1]. Figure 3 traces one such ordering through recorded run, from the plan line written before any frame was read to the two measured windows that settle it.

sections.title: 4.4 Physical measurements and evidence records
sections.content: Physical claims are settled by eleven operations sharing one grounding step: SAM 3 segments the named subject and tracks its identity across frames, and every operation measures over those tracks. Each maps to class of human complaint in the corpus. The largest class is displacement: the dominant complaint is that something the prompt sets in motion does not move or moves the wrong way (e.g. static sun), with ballistic arcs comparatively rare. Three conventions make it measurable: it is reported in multiples of the subjects own radius, so no scene calibration is needed; direction is taken from the furthest excursion, not the net, since rise then fall cancels; and camera motion is removed by dense whole-frame optical flow, needing no stationary landmark. Three further operations cover failures with no net travel: contact measures the closest approach between two tracked masks (finer than box overlap); shape change measures surface motion relative to the background flow (a scroll rolling in place, which displacement reports as zero); and path shape distinguishes circle from figure of eight. The rest cover time and existence: permanence, whether subject that should vanish persists; hop counting, whether one that should leave the ground does; damping, spinning object that never slows; onset ordering, which of two events comes first (or never happens); clip timing for duration and playback rate; and viewpoint motion, separating moving camera from moving subject. All eleven return number with its evidenceframes read, tracker used, threshold appliedleaving the decision to Section 4.5. Each may also abstain: subject under one percent of the frame, or track too short to measure, yields an explicit abstention, so an unmeasurable claim never resolves as supported. Evidence records and provenance. Each action is serialized as claim-bound record Rj,i = (cid:0)id(V), p, si, oj, Ωj, σj, µj, hj, κj (cid:1), σj {measured, abstained, errored}. (9) The payload µj contains either typed measurement or an explicitly tagged learned base state; hj contains the native-output and artifact hashes; and κj contains calls and accelerator time, with optional wall time, price, and token counts. Shared execution may bind the same record to several claims, but its cost is charged once by execution identifier. The three statuses are mutually exclusive: measured carries payload and no abstention or error; abstained carries reason and no payload; errored carries an infrastructure message. valid negative measurementa complete usable track lacking the requested motionstays measured and may contradict claim, whereas failure to track from blur, occlusion, low quality, or an instrument refusal is abstained, not negative observation. The counting path can blur this: the mode of an intermittently grounded per-frame series can report confident zero when grounding merely failed on most frames, indistinguishable from true absencehence the auxiliary fields (stable, range, frames read) are load-bearing, and Section 7 flags the consequence for count-derived figures. terminal errored record is retried; if still terminal, we mark the clip infra and exclude it from the evaluation set rather than relabeling it unknown. Specialist schemas reject judgment-shaped fields, nonfinite numbers, duplicate keys, and noncanonical payloads; every record carries the full prompt and verbatim span si, with heavy artifacts content-addressed by path and byte hash. This guarantees specialist cannot emit the final prompt-satisfaction label and that accepted evidence is attributable and replayablethough it cannot unbias learned measurement nor detect well-formed but wrong payload.

sections.title: 4.5 Verdict aggregation and diagnostics
sections.content: A deterministic roll-up composes per-sub-check states into per-claim states and then the clip decision (Equation (10)); two learned refinements then act on top of it, and the run emits localized contradiction packet (Equation (11)) as its diagnostic interface. For completed trace, every sub-check resolves in = {S, C, U}, standing for supported, contradicted, and unknown. typed resolver ψq maps the measurements µj of its prerequisite actions Pa(q) in GΠ to sub-check state zq: when all required actions are measured it applies ψq; if any abstained or returned no usable evidence the state is U; and terminal infrastructure error gives infra. The resolver is deterministic for count, timing, track, transcription, and other explicit predicates, and learned only for the semantic sub-checks named above, where it uses an asymmetric gate: it may contradict 10 only when positively contradicting feature is visible, so that unresolved evidence, unparseable output, or missing modality yields rather than turning an instrument failure into an accusation about the video. Negation is applied to the positive sub-check state, never by asking tool to measure negative quantity: 3S = C, 3C = S, and 3U = U. Let Ki = {q : b(q) = i} be the validated checks for claim ci, after applying this negation where required. Claim and clip composition are yi = C, Ki : zq = C, Ki : zq = S, S, otherwise, U, = the trace terminates with an infrastructure error, infra, Implausible, : yi = C, Plausible, Abstain, Np 1 : yi = S, otherwise. (10) One contradiction makes the clip implausible, and Plausible asserts only over the claims the plan executed. Those two refinements are as follows. First, stronger reviewing model re-examines claims the video-aware verifier passed, and its verdict stands: overruling pass resolves the claim to contradicted rather than unknown, replacing yi where the sub-checks would otherwise roll up to S. Both verdicts are recorded, so row can be re-scored on the first verifiers alone. The direction is asymmetric by design: the reviewer examines only passed claims, never specialist measurement, which carries evidence second opinion cannot inspect. Second, recognition engine reads frames directly to settle text claims: generative model asked what sign says repairs what it seesrendering malformed Stly your as the well-formed Style your the prompt requested, concealing the defect under testwhereas recognition head returns the malformed string, which deterministic comparison rejects. It reads every frame rather than sampled fraction, since caption present for part of clip can fall between samples, and each record states the frames read. Beyond the clip state , run emits localized contradiction packet F(p, V) = (cid:8)(cid:0)ci, {Rj,i}j, Ωi, Bi (cid:1) : yi = C(cid:9) , (11) where Ωi is the union of available temporal support and Bi contains available box tracks or masks. The packet is assembled from the trace that produced the verdict, so each contradicted claim carries both the evidence records behind the conclusion and the region of the clip in which the failure occurs: what failed, on what evidence, and where. That spacetime localization is what Section maps onto local edit of the generator control (Section B.4, (21)). Closed-loop refinement is not run in this report: (11) defines the interface only, the critic and simulation-conditioned generator are evaluated on disjoint data, and no VeriPhy packet has been used for preference optimization, denoising guidance, candidate selection, or localized regenerationso we claim no clip has been made more physically correct by the critic.

sections.title: 5 Experiments
sections.content: This section evaluates the system in the order the pipeline builds it. Section 5.1 sets out the shared setupthe human-annotated flaw benchmark and the recall metrics and matching protocol every result is scored under. Section 5.2 takes the physics-guided generator : whether the geometric control governs the motion, when the trajectory commits, and how far the scene library reaches. Section 5.3 takes the VeriPhy critic: its flaw recall on the evaluation core, against the annotated reference and published evaluators, and its agreement with human ratings. Section 5.4 takes the context-training self-evolution of the criticwhether lessons distilled from recorded misses raise recall without touching weightand Section 5.5 closes the critics outward channel, feeding verdict back as prompt rewrite that regenerates the clip. The evaluations use distinct held-out settings that should not be conflated; Section 5.6 sets them side by side.

The generating model is not recorded, no clip is attributed to specific system, and the human-written fields are ground truth throughout. Each flaw is localized record with four always-present fieldsthe violated fragment, free-text rationale, severity, and the annotators confidenceand two optional, time span and box track. Two grouping tagsa modality tag (seen, heard, or both) and ten-item type tagare machine-assigned by majority of three zero-temperature model votes and never treated as ground truth. Unlike clip-level resourcesPhysion-Eval [88], VideoPhy-2 [4], and per-dimension suites such as VBench [31] and T2V-CompBench [68]our corpus ties each failure to the exact prompt words with an optional time span and box track, so an allegation can be matched to particular annotated failure rather than only correlated with clip-level score. This localization does not improve reliability: our corpus is single-annotator and contains only flawed clips, whereas VideoPhy-2 provides redundant judgments and majority resolution. 12 5.1.2 Reference standard and matching protocol The evaluation core is the reference standard: its 149 clips carry 304 annotated flawsthe denominator for all core recall analyses. Because every clip carries at least one flaw, recall is directly measurable but precision is not (a detector flagging everything scores perfect recall), so we report recall alongside the rate at which accusations land on real flaw. Recall counts flaw entries, not distinct spans, since matching claims each entry at most once. Matching, run after critic inference, cannot affect the critics outputs. The comparison unit is sentence pair (annotator vs. critic), judged by meaning as whole match (same defect), partial match (critic identifies at least one aspect of compound annotated defect), or non-match. Whole and partial pairings are candidate edges for maximum bipartite matching, each finding and flaw used at most once; every flaw is then reported as whole, partial, or missed. The matching judge, distinct from all evaluated components, votes at temperature zero with retry-and-refallback rule and aborts rather than reporting number if more than 2% of flaws yield no usable outcome.

sections.title: 5.2 The physics-guided generator
sections.content: Three questions organize the generator experiments: whether the geometric control overrides prompt-implied motion (Section 5.2.2), when conditioned trajectory becomes insensitive to control withdrawal (Section 5.2.3), and how the pipeline behaves beyond single-body probes (Section 5.2.4). The first and third use the deployed generator; the release analysis is separate mechanism probe on the second backbone, its withdrawal operation defined in Section 3.4. 5.2.1 Setup: from simulation to controllable clip The deployed backbone is Wan 2.2-VACE-Fun-14B (WanVACEPipeline, fixed negative prompt, no appearance reference, deterministic sampling from the recorded seed). Scenes are simulated in MuJoCo and rendered to 81 frames at 16 fps; as the simulated duration varies, this render clock stretches playback by 1.82.3, so trajectory shape and event order come from the simulation but absolute speed does not equal simulator time. Generation is stagedcontrols rendered first, 1.3B checkpoint screening each scene once, visibly degenerate outputs not queued for the 14B model (a pipeline rule, not generator property). Surviving scenes are generated in bf16 at 848 480 with UniPC at 50 steps and guidance 5.0, conditioned on the control video (globally normalized MuJoCo depth, or silhouette for predeclared flat-scene templates), an all-white mask, and the prompt; the conditioning scale is = 1.0 deployed, examined separately at {0.5, 0.8, 1.0}. 5.2.2 Control fidelity under prompt variation We fix the geometric controlone projectile-depth videoand vary only the motion clause across three prompts sharing subject, scene, camera, material and style: strong horizontal traverse, neutral one, or one adversarial to the control (drops nearly straight down, almost no sideways motion). sections.title: 6 Conclusion
sections.content: A quality score can rank two clips; it cannot identify which physical obligation was violated, or when. Work on physical faithfulness in generated video divides into three separate pieces: way to steer what gets generated, way to measure whether obligations are met, and source of ground truth to score those measurements against. Closing the gap takes all three at once. This report builds one artifact for each and connects them into single loop: simulation-driven controllable generator (MuJoCo Wan 2.2-VACE) in which the solver fixes the motion and the prompt supplies only appearance; benchmark of human-annotated defects localized to the offending prompt words, time span, and box track; and critic, VeriPhy, that compiles the prompt into typed physical obligations before it reads any frame, then calls frozen experts only within the scope those obligations declare. That ordering is the central design decision. Because the plan is fixed before any pixel is read, every measurement traces back to the obligation that asked for it, and every verdict (supported/contradicted/unknown, surfaced as plausible, implausible, or abstain) carries the evidence that forced it. On development core of 149 clips carrying 304 human-marked defects, VeriPhy accounts for 228, against 164 for published question-decomposition evaluator reading the same clips with the same served model. Prompting that backbone monolithically reaches 222, so recall alone does not separate the two. What separates them is that reader can open any one of VeriPhys 228 findings and see the measurement that produced it, the time window it was taken over, and the rule that turned it into verdict. The same reader can overturn that verdict by disputing the evidence. The monolithic prompt returns score with no supporting evidence. An auditable state is also improvable without retraining. Distilling lessons from experience clips and loading them as readable context lifts recall from 340 of 502 held-out flaws to 375 (67.7% 74.7%, net +35 at = 3104), with no lesson evaluated on the prompt it was written from (Section 5.4). The gain saturates quickly: lessons distilled from 25 clips already find 375, the count also reached with 117 clips, and the four taught conditions differ by no more than 3 (375, 377, 374, 375). Later lessons change which flaws are found rather than how many. small, legible body of experience, in the form of text human can read, audit, and 26 Figure 15 What the critic flagged, and the clip the rewrite regeneratedclips VeriPhy judged implausible and resampled through (12). Each case is two real filmstrips: the baseline clip (grey) and the clip regenerated from the rewritten prompt (rewrite, red), six frames early to late; red boxes mark the cited physical violation and its repair, and the full regenerated prompt is printed verbatim beneath. Cases were chosen by an independent frame-by-frame review under an honesty constraintthe before/after must be the same scene, not rewrite that swaps the scene or introduces new artifactwhich most flagged clips fail; these are cases where the fix is visible and the comparison fair. Two further cases are in Figure 16; the quantitative reading is Figure 14. Figure 16 Critic-guided rewrite, continued, in the layout of Figure 15: frisbee that warps into red ball mid-flight, held to single rigid object by the rewrite, and soccer ball that duplicates during the kicktwo balls in the baseline (boxed), one in the rewrite. Red boxes mark the flagged defect and its repair; the full rewritten prompt is printed verbatim beneath each. 28 edit, does work otherwise done by fine-tuning, and it accrues to state that stays inspectable instead of being absorbed into model parameters. The outward channel is less developed, and its evidence is split. Feeding verdict and its violated obligations back as prompt rewrite, then resampling under the same control and seed, closes the critic-to-generator loop end to end on Cosmos3-Nano, generator held out from this systems development. On the metric the rewrite optimizes, the loop behaves as designed: it fires on 87 of 589 clips (14.8%), improves 63 of those 87, flips 49 of 65 implausible verdicts to plausible, and regresses 8 of the 502 it leaves alone (1.6%). An independent rater sharing no component with the critic registers no corresponding movement in either the physical or the semantic dimension (Section 5.5). The disagreement is the result: it localizes the open problem to the rewrite channel itself, which at present can edit only words. Whether text-only edit can move generators physics, or whether the correction must instead enter through the geometric control channel this report builds, is an open question this setup can now measure. The next direction is one this system is already built for and does not yet use: sound. Audio resolves physical implausibility that vision leaves ambiguous. visible collision that is silent, or an impact heard before contact, breaks causality in way visual fluency cannot conceal, and it does so on timeline that can be measured rather than judged. VeriPhy already carries sound-event specialist, and the architecture already places audio intervals and visual contact windows on one shared event clock, which is what synchrony claim requires: contact window from vision, an onset from audio, and typed relation between them, with an abstain when either stream is unusable. This report does not exercise that capacity; every measured claim here is visual. Extending physical verification across modalities, with obligations that bind what is seen to what is heard and benchmark that localizes audiovisual faults as precisely as this one localizes visual ones, is what we build next. Section casts these components as single state-optimization framework, and Section lays out the phased plan that carries them there.

sections.title: 7 Limitations
sections.content: The primary limitation of this work is that the control signal comes from simulator, so scene diversity is bounded by what is simulated, and the mapping from simulation to prompt appearance is not itself verified for physical consistency. The corpus used here is also recall-only (no clean clips), so precision is not directly measurable; flaws are single-annotator with no inter-annotator agreement; the scope/category tags are machine-derived; and the source generator of the clips is unrecorded. Repeatedly designing against one frozen set risks overfitting to it even without training on it. Moreover, the spatial relation predicate and negative-event verification are limited; binding remains central failure mode, since the compiler enforces symbolic identifier consistency but cannot guarantee that heterogeneous tools localized the same physical instance; and the reasoner-mediated sub-checks reduce but do not remove semantic opacity. Four limits bound what Section B.7 establishes. The acceptance gate (23) is not exercised, so the measurement covers distillation without the admission discipline that is meant to keep bad lesson out; rule written from fresh miss has no proxy history, and closing that gap needs Uval defined on unrun rules. The taught planner reads 1.76 times as many claims out of prompt as the untaught one, and flaw recall rewards asking more, so the effect combines better-targeted plan with larger one; run holding the taught arm to the untaught arms question budget would separate them. The lessons are induced once from fixed pool rather than accumulated online, so the curve of Figure 12 measures the effect of the amount of experience distilled, not of accumulating it during deployment; the shape beyond 117 experience clips is unmeasured. Finally, the 502-flaw held-out set is different population from the 304-flaw evaluation core used everywhere else in this paper, and the two rates should not be compared directly. Every distilled prior is critic-derived rather than ground truth, and retrieval quality, staleness, and the propagation of wrong prior remain open. The operator set and the external channel are untouched: growing the operator library through multimodal distillation [6, 48, 81] and admitting external knowledge under candidate-and-prune discipline [30] are future work.
